display_name: PAMF 去参考响应：完整论文实验补齐
description: 11数据条件×监督/普通PL增强四格及完整半监督，完整方法扩至8种子；补齐四个分类损失结构控制与8种子E200架构对照。复用已完成三分支面板和四外部方法；从零补齐缺失模型。

roles.U_s: source IQ; TX=-1; only PL/SSL rows

permissions.regime: Fixed supervised, ordinary PL, or full Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; CE structure and E200 are supervised only
permissions.query_use: Both target populations and every registered view/readout freeze before independent CPU truth-last scoring
permissions.claim_scope: Exposed development benchmark; original external-method objective and augmentation differences disclosed

checkpoint.initialization: 184 new models scratch; 6 exact same-contract no-reference PAMF models reused; 36 completed branch models and 528 external method results reused
sources: 20261027 PAMF no-reference SSL and one-view CE completed sources
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact data roles, source config, seed, frozen predictions and independent score per reused row
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Explicit source, no target feedback, source contract and readout checks; no new G training
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final source epoch and fixed preregistered rows; no target feedback

expected_artifacts: 6 reused exact-contract PAMF sources and scores
184 missing frozen predictions and independent CPU scores
fixed six-target source-receiver curve and paired seed statistics
historical 14-network E200 clean results and new 8-seed paired architecture comparison
final per-seed, summary, paired, structural and report artifacts
